Data set updates: SMAP Level-4

The SMAP Level-4 data sets, available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC), have been updated to a new minor version for data beginning 1 August 2023. This update makes improvements to L1C_TB quality control, IMERG late inputs, and a geolocation issue fix (14 May 2026 to 28 July 2026).  These changes are reflected in updated Science Version IDs (Vv8012, Vv8013).
New data set release: Near Real-Time VIIRS/JPSS-1 L3 Global Daily 500m SIN Grid Snow Cover, Grain Size, and Dust Radiative Forcing, Version 1
Near Real-Time VIIRS/JPSS-1 L3 Global Daily 500m SIN Grid Snow Cover, Grain Size, and Dust Radiative Forcing, Version 1

data set is now available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC). This data set includes parameters from two different algorithms: snow fraction, snow grain size, vegetation fraction, rock fraction, ice fraction, and shade fraction from the SCAG algorithm and snow darkening, radiative forcing, and snow grain size from the DRFS algorithm.

SMOS-Based SMAP L2 Radiometer Half-Orbit 9 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture
SMAP/SMOS L3 Radiometer 9 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture
, Version 2 datasets, available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC), have been updated through 9 October 2026.
User notice: SMAP data reprocessing complete

, available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC), have been reprocessed from 14 May 2026 to 28 July 2026 to correct for a geolocation issue discovered in August 2026. We recommend that users who previously downloaded data from that time period redownload the corrected files.
New version release: IceBridge BedMachine Greenland, Version 7
IceBridge BedMachine Greenland, Version 7

is now available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC). This data set contains a bed topography and bathymetry map of Greenland, as well as surface elevation and ice thickness data. This version of the dataset uses Ice Flow Perturbation Analysis to better reconstruct the bedrock topography beneath the ice sheet.
Data set retirement: ATLAS/ICESat-2 L3A Along Track Coastal and Nearshore Bathymetry, Version 1
ATLAS/ICESat-2 L3A Along Track Coastal and Nearshore Bathymetry, Version 1

will be retired from the NSIDC DAAC on 23 November 2026. Upon retirement, data will no longer be accessible, but all related documentation will remain available on the data set’s web page for future reference. We recommend using the latest version of these data sets, found under the “more recent version” link on the web pages.
New versions release: ATLAS/ICESat-2 L3B Gridded Antarctic and Arctic Land Ice Height and Land Ice Height Change, Versions 6
ATLAS/ICESat-2 L3B Gridded Antarctic and Arctic Land Ice Height, Version 6
ATLAS/ICESat-2 L3B Gridded Antarctic and Arctic Land Ice Height Change, Version 6

(ATL15) are now available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC). The ATL14 data set contains 100m DEM models of land ice height, while ATL15 has varying spatial resolutions of land ice height change in the same regions.
User notice: OpenAltimetry updated to include ATLAS/ICESat-2 Along Track Coastal and Nearshore Bathymetry, Version 2

The NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC) is pleased to announce that the OpenAltimetry web application has been updated to include ATLAS/ICESat-2 Nearshore Bathymetry, Version 2 (ATL24).
User Notice: S-NPP/Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) data sets - Cessation of Data Delivery

Delivery of science data products from the Suomi National Polar-orbiting Partnership (Suomi NPP) satellite is expected to cease at 13:00 Universal Time (UTC) on November 2, 2026. After this date, access to the historical data and documentation will still be available, but delivery of new S-NPP VIIRS data sets into the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC) will cease.
User notice: Bootstrap Sea Ice Concentrations from Nimbus-7 SMMR and DMSP SSM/I-SSMIS, Version 4
Bootstrap Sea Ice Concentrations from Nimbus-7 SMMR and DMSP SSM/I-SSMIS, Version 4

dataset, available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC), has stopped forward processing. The final temporal coverage for the data is 1 November 1978 to 31 December 2025. The data will remain available for download as a static product at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC).
New data set release: ICESat-2 Cal/Val 2022 L2 CHIR Green Wavelength Lidar Arctic Sea Ice Heights and Bathymetry, Version 1
ICESat-2 Cal/Val 2022 L2 CHIR Green Wavelength Lidar Arctic Sea Ice Heights and Bathymetry, Version 1

is now available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC). This data set contains Arctic summer sea ice heights and bathymetry with the primary purpose to evaluate the positional accuracies of NASA’s ICESat-2 ATLAS measurements.
User notice: AMSR2 products continued forward processing

The AMSR2 satellite-based data products, available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC), will continue forward processing, as the data remain available from the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA). NSIDC is planning for the development of AMSR3 data products in 2027, but AMSR2 data products will continue to be available until JAXA ends processing. NSIDC is planning to develop AMSR3 data products in the future.

User notice: SMAP data reprocessing
SMAP Standard and Near Real-Time

data sets, available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC), experienced a geolocation issue from 14 May 2026 to 28 July 2026. All Standard products for that time period are currently being reprocessed and will be replaced in the coming weeks. Near Real-Time products will not be replaced.
Data set update: DMSP SSM/I-SSMIS Daily Polar Gridded Brightness Temperatures, Version 6
DMSP SSM/I-SSMIS Daily Polar Gridded Brightness Temperatures, Version 6

data set, accessible through the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC), has been updated through 5 July 2026. This data set provides daily gridded brightness temperatures derived from passive microwave sensors and distributed in a polar stereographic projection.
New data set release: ICESat-2 Calibration/Validation LVIS L3A Sea Ice Freeboard, Version 1
ICESat-2 Calibration/Validation LVIS L3A Sea Ice Freeboard, Version 1

is now available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC). This data set contains high-resolution sea ice freeboard estimates derived from airborne measurements collected over the Arctic Ocean.

New data set release: High Mountain Asia MODIS/Terra L3 Daily 500m SIN Grid Spatially and Temporally Complete (STC) Snow Cover and Snow Surface Properties, Version 1
High Mountain Asia MODIS/Terra L3 Daily 500m SIN Grid Spatially and Temporally Complete (STC) Snow Cover and Snow Surface Properties, Version 1

is now available at the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC). This data set contains spatially and temporally complete (STC) raster images of snow cover and snow surface properties from 1 October 2000 through 30 June 2022 for the High Mountain Asia region.
